Added local storage of decks.

### Download

**[Download BetterCollectionManager.dll for BepInEx](https://github.com/UltiKon/Better-Collection-Manager/releases/download/0.3.0/BetterCollectionManager.dll)**

For an existing **BepInEx 5 Unity Mono** installation. Place the DLL in
`BepInEx/plugins/BetterCollectionManager/` and restart Hearthstone.

### What's new

- Archive decks locally, separated by account, and switch between **Saved** and **Archived (local)** in the deck list.
- Edit archived decks in the native editor, including offline or when the saved-deck list is full. Changes persist locally across restarts.
- Use **Archive instead** in the native delete confirmation. The local snapshot is written and verified before deleting the saved deck.
- Restore archived decks while online with a free saved slot. The local archive is kept until the server confirms a matching saved deck.
- Preserve card editions, quantities, qualities, sideboards, format and deck cosmetics.
- Enable or disable the feature in **Settings → Mods → Deck archive**; disabling keeps existing archives.
- Added **Report A Bug** under **Other**, opening GitHub Issues. Its button matches the section heading width.
- Improved archive/restore icons and restored native delete-popup button sounds.
- Deferred empty-filter preparation until the filter menu opens; removed temporary profiling and unused legacy UI helpers.

### Other downloads

- [BepInEx package](https://github.com/UltiKon/Better-Collection-Manager/releases/download/0.3.0/BetterCollectionManager-0.3.0-bepinex.zip) — DLL, source, documentation and checksums.
- [MelonLoader package](https://github.com/UltiKon/Better-Collection-Manager/releases/download/0.3.0/BetterCollectionManager-0.3.0-shareable.zip) — matching MelonLoader DLL, source, documentation and checksums.

Both loader variants contain the same 0.3.0 features. Use one loader variant per launch.
Local archives belong to this device and account; back them up when moving installations.

### Validation

Both Release builds, loader metadata/configuration checks, managed regression suites,
native API metadata checks and package integrity checks are verified before publication.
A user has tested the local archive and settings under Nobara/Linux with Wine and BepInEx.
MelonLoader runtime behavior, Windows and macOS have not been newly verified for this release.

See the [installation guide](https://github.com/UltiKon/Better-Collection-Manager/blob/0.3.0/README.md#how-to-install).
